caption:
Finding the flow on a high-altitude ridge requires more than just fitness; it requires reading the terrain. When mountain biking in Costa Rica, the transitions between steep climbs and technical descents happen in seconds. I design every My Adventure Costa Rica journey to embrace these shifts, testing every climb myself to ensure we find the perfect balance of challenge and perspective.
